notes: SpotFeed is a third named SwarmFeed artifact, added so the manifest can name the vault's three feeds separately: a manifest identifies a deployment by contract name and has no alias field, so deploying PriceFeed twice was unrepresentable and parked the launch. CDPVault takes the existing MockIMD collateral (never redeployed), zero CompToken and zero work oracle so it creates and permanently binds both during construction, then the three feed addresses. Feed authority, payload chainId 1, answerType 3, quorum 1 and the vault scalars are pinned in DeploymentConfig.sol and are not manifest arguments. Both price feeds and the NHI feed start unseeded. LaunchToken is COMP Launch (CPL), 18 decimals, separate from the elastic CompToken the vault mints.
